title: Linen gray block table cloth
text: Linen gray block table cloth. This is a lovely light/medium gray table cloth with fringe.  The "print" is embroidered line - creating a block/check print.  It's just simple and pretty.  I am using it as a cover for a kitchen equipment cart I have.  It works perfectly - like a dust cover for my equipment and hides them for a neat look.  It would be lovely on a table too!  It will need pressing - it is a linen blend - if you're using as a table cloth.
